name: Agentic IDE
summary: IDE for directing artificial organizations rather than merely chatting with agents.

name: Mission Command Console
summary: Primary serious operating interface; should precede animated world.

name: Army Command World
summary: Alternative spatial/gamified projection over the same operational state.

name: Spatial Command Language
summary: Location, zoom, target, formation, movement and gesture encode context and commands.

name: Semantic Zoom
summary: Zoom company→campaign→operation→team→agent→task/tool while preserving context.

name: Target Lock
summary: Set one object as the operator context and reorganize relevant UI around it.

name: Surveillance Mode
summary: Anomaly-only view for incidents, blockers, queues, spend, uncertainty and approvals.

name: Rapid Task Force
summary: Automatically recommend and deploy a team for mission requirements.

name: Reinforcement Router
summary: Route help to the best available specialist/team based on evidence and availability.

name: Distress Signal
summary: Structured intelligent help request replacing broad manual broadcasts.

name: Hot Drop Specialist
summary: Insert specialist with compiled context and permissions.

name: Recon Mission
summary: Cheap uncertainty-reduction pass before expensive execution.

name: Fog of War
summary: Visual representation of unknown or low-confidence mission state.

name: Cognitive Logistics / Supply Lines
summary: Context, credentials, tools, compute, budget and dependencies visualized as supply.

name: Signals Network
summary: Consequential communication channels and overlays.

name: Collision Control
summary: Detect duplicate work, overlapping changes, conflicting assumptions and resource collisions.

name: Smart Handoff
summary: Typed context/state transfer between agents or teams.

name: Formations
summary: Reusable execution topologies such as Spearhead, Swarm, Recon Screen, Shield Wall and Column.

name: Formation Compiler
summary: Compile visual agent arrangements into executable team topology.

name: Nested Service Designations
summary: Arbitrarily deep configurable organization tree/graph.

name: Organization Node
summary: Parent-linked entity owning policy, doctrine, metrics, capabilities and resources.

name: Commander's Intent
summary: Frozen/explicit outcome objective and constraints propagated through missions.

name: Rules of Engagement
summary: Autonomy, authority, approval and safety policy.

name: After-Action Report
summary: Structured outcome, tactics, failures, reusable lessons and candidate doctrine.

name: Operational Doctrine
summary: Versioned validated reusable organization/workflow pattern.

name: War Game
summary: Controlled champion/challenger simulation and evaluation.

name: After-Action Replay
summary: Causal replay with counterfactual restart from earlier point.

name: Advanced Projects Command
summary: Autonomous improvement organization mining company experience for high-leverage changes.

name: Leverage Board
summary: Multi-objective opportunity ranking against Commander's Intent.

name: Workflow Compression
summary: Mine repeated stable agent sequences and convert to deterministic tools/skills.

name: Recurring Failure Rate
summary: Share of failure volume that repeats known failure families.

name: Preventable Recurrence Rate
summary: Recurring incidents where sufficient preventive knowledge/control already existed.

name: Post-Fix Recurrence Rate
summary: Failure families marked fixed that later recur.

name: Time to Recurrence
summary: Time from claimed remediation to next incident in same family.

name: Failure Family
summary: Semantically grouped root-cause class across incidents.

name: Organizational Learning Chain
summary: Knowledge exist→retrieve→deliver→understand→follow→prevent.

name: Social Army Base
summary: Persistent remote-company world for humans and agents.

name: Team Headquarters
summary: Spatial home for each team/unit.

name: Bug Zoo
summary: Memorable recurring bugs/failure families as collectible historical entities.

name: Failed Experiment Graveyard
summary: Celebrate cheap informative failures and preserve lessons.

name: Zeus/Olympus World
summary: Earlier mythology-based world; retained only as reference.
